Text: doc-url: on the office PC open a GST/portal page in Edge, Chrome and Firefox (also one in F11 full screen, one in a popup window, and one PDF viewer tab), then run: venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/sgt_probe_pack.py doc-url   Report is ~/AmanAssociates_Sera/logs/probe_pack_<date>.txt (never commit it). Fill blueprint section 12 rows 'Document Value/URL in Edge/Chrome/Firefox, full screen, popup' (per browser: 'Value is a URL' vs 'documents', 'equal to the address bar') -> decides D1; and the row 'PDF viewer exposes text through UIA' (PDF viewer line YES/NO) -> C4.

read-timing (incl. R9): open the heaviest real page you have (GSTR-1 B2B with hundreds of rows) in the browser, then run: venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/sgt_probe_pack.py read-timing --minutes 240   Then, with TWO windows of the SAME browser on portal pages: venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/sgt_probe_pack.py read-timing --two-windows --minutes 10   Fill section 12 rows 'full read of a real B2B page, element-by-element vs cached (ms, element count)' and 'read-time growth over hours' (first quarter -> last quarter of the SUMMARY) -> D2 (STA side); the two-windows SUMMARY verdict SERIALISED/PARALLEL/PARTLY (and its ratio) settles R9's one-heavy-read-per-browser rule.

read-timing --mta: same page and same hours as the plain read-timing run, so the two compare: venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/sgt_probe_pack.py read-timing --minutes 240 --mta   Fill the section 12 row 'read-time growth over hours, STA vs MTA' with the MTA numbers (ms median/p95/max, first quarter -> last quarter, timeouts, 'read worker' abandoned/stuck line) next to the STA ones -> decides D2 (keep STA or move the read worker to MTA).

gate: work normally on a portal page in front (type invoice rows, let a toast / banner / modal / spinner appear) and note the clock time of each: venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/sgt_probe_pack.py gate --minutes 5   Fill section 12 rows 'frame tick cost' (TOTAL 'frame tick ms' median/p95) -> D7 and R10: 0.2 s tick if a tick costs under 15 ms, else the 0.35 s fallback; and 'cells changed by typing/caret/spinner/toast/banner/modal' (histogram and 'largest changes' matched to your notes, plus how often the legacy hash fired vs >= GATE_MIN_CELLS 3 / FLASH_MIN_CELLS 8) -> D4.

toast: do a REAL filing yourself (the tool submits nothing) while this runs on the portal tab in front: venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/sgt_probe_pack.py toast --minutes 20   Fill section 12 row 'ARN visibility UIA vs OCR plus what FlashWatcher catches' from the 'ARN visibility' lines (visible seconds per channel, sample interval, FlashWatcher caught / did not) and the OCR ms line -> D5 (and the C1-C3 capture-channel choice). Add --no-ocr if OCR is unavailable on that PC.

switches: during a normal hour of B2B work run: venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/sgt_probe_pack.py switches --minutes 60   It keeps counts only (no titles, links or text). Fill section 12 row 'foreground/tab switches per minute' with the TOTAL foreground changes and tab changes per minute median/max -> D1 (how often the page identity must be re-resolved) and D4 (harness profile 1: how bursty switching is).

OWNER: read the HUD wording and D8. Title 'Capture paused on this PC' with one fixed sentence per state (stalled, uia-paused, blind, scope-lost, busy-long, specs-silent, disk; unlisted-portal keeps the router's own prompt and only phones), recovery 'Capture back to normal'. D8: blind after 20 s with a failed read, HUD at most once per 60 s per state and repeating every 5 min, phone at most once per 30 min per state and inside the shared hourly limit. Pass = wording is clear to staff and the timings feel right; fail = say what to change.

After a normal working day on the dev PC, look at ~/AmanAssociates_Sera/sgt_shadow/: undelivered_rows.jsonl should be absent or empty (rows that were retried and then replayed leave no file). If it exists, count its lines and send the count; also count undelivered_rows_held.jsonl (rows a retry cannot fix). Pass: both are zero or the retryable file empties within 10 minutes of the database being free. Never copy these files into the repo (they hold client data).

Equivalence on the real corpus (14.2 gate on the Core): run venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/sgt_lines_equivalence.py (synthetic + corpus). Pass: the last line says PASS; the corpus section says 'all identical', or 0 comparable records if the corpus still has no node dumps (then say so in the reply).

Equivalence on three live pages, reader v2 included (D1, D2 as built): with no browser sidebar or extension pane open, put a portal page in front and run venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/sgt_lines_equivalence.py --skip-corpus --title "<words from its window title>" for (1) a GST return page, (2) an Income Tax page, (3) a large GSTR-1 B2B list; once in Edge or Chrome, once in Firefox. Pass: each run ends PASS and its 'reader v2:' line shows error=none (MTA init works, D2) and rule=document in Edge/Chrome (Document URL works, D1); Firefox may show document or address_bar.

D7 frame tick (WP4 STOP): after check #4 (gate probe) comes back, read its 'frame tick ms' line. Pass for 0.2 s: median screenshot+signature under 15 ms -> set FRAME_TICK_SEC = FRAME_TICK_FAST_SEC in core/vsdc/vsdc_capture.py; otherwise keep 0.35 s (R10). Fill section 12's frame-tick row.

Capture loop day run (WP4 done-when): with SGT on (shadow or live), work a normal day on the dev PC, then look at logs/vsdc.log heartbeat lines. Pass: they show uia_reads counts rising, late=0 (no dropped reads), loop_errors absent or 0, and the GST/ITR rows of the day appear in the tracker as before; no health state stalled/uia-paused except during real browser hangs. Fail: send the heartbeat lines' counts (no page text).

Replay diff on the real corpus (WP5 STOP, D3): on the dev PC run 'venv/Scripts/python.exe tools/sgt_replay.py diff' against the replay_baseline.json made at WB (re-run 'baseline' first only if it is missing). PASS = every line is 'newly written' (OCR-only rows with an ARN) or no lines at all; FAIL = any 'no longer written' or 'changed' line, especially a PAN/name/period/status that came from an OCR page before (OCR no longer sets the profile, changes pieces or raises a status without an ARN). Read the output on the PC only; do not paste values anywhere.
